const.command_authority_no_self_bootstrap: Command actor identity does not itself grant authority. Command acceptance must validate authority from expected parent history context or exact installation bootstrap trust root; same-commit authority object cannot authorize the command that accepts it.
const.commit_closure_order: One Kahn topological sort over UNION graph = typed same-commit content-reference dependency edges + exact active scope-bound order-only precedence edges from pinned ArtifactContractRegistry/profile; zero-indegree tie-break=(kind,logical_id_or_empty,revision_digest); order-only edges affect ordering/cycle detection only and never satisfy reference/authority/provenance requirements.
const.continuation_authorization: proposal accepted/consumed atomically with transition; no independent current ticket lifecycle
const.history_reference: prior accepted input cut only; initialization uses EMPTY_HISTORY plus explicitly allowed same-commit bootstrap content refs ordered by deterministic closure; EMPTY_HISTORY forbidden after seq=1
const.initialization_bootstrap: seq=1 only: exact INSTALLATION_BOOTSTRAP_PROFILE_V1 pin; EMPTY_HISTORY history input; BDB_BOOTSTRAP_PRECEDENCE_V1 is mandatory and imposes machine-readable order-only domain-group precedence CommandEnvelope→SourceGeneration→legacy raw→mechanical→source reconciliation→lineage→optional exposure→selection→bootstrap admission→CampaignGenesis; typed-ref edges remain mandatory; union graph must be acyclic; blocked admission forbids genesis; no synthetic H0.
const.initialization_command_context: INITIALIZE_CAMPAIGN_FROM_LEGACY: campaign_ref forbidden; proposed_campaign_id/history_namespace_ref/bootstrap_profile_ref required; no future ref to CampaignGenesis
const.input_disposition_scope_state_separation: InputDisposition.PROVISIONAL and ScopeState.PROVISIONAL_SCOPE are distinct typed values. Cross-domain substitution is ENUM_DOMAIN_MISMATCH; neither satisfies terminal accounting/completion.
const.projection_rule: derived views/reports cannot establish or override accepted facts
const.reference_array_ordering: All material-ref arrays are set-like canonical typed-ref sorted with duplicate rejection unless a contract ordering_rules field explicitly declares an ordered sequence/topological order.
const.same_commit_content_reference: earlier node in deterministic acyclic canonical closure; reachability/ref integrity derives only from typed content refs, never from order-only precedence edges

schema.const: For registered semantic objects, ObjectDigest(kind,version,body) MUST use the exact registry kind string. command_envelope and commit_body have no alternate command/commit digest-domain aliases.

BDB_BOOTSTRAP_PRECEDENCE_V1.activation_semantics: Exact scope match and exact pinned profile identity are required. No prose-derived, latest, wildcard, fallback, or non-initialization activation is allowed.
BDB_BOOTSTRAP_PRECEDENCE_V1.edge_semantics: ORDER_ONLY: participates in canonical closure ordering and union-graph cycle detection only; does not create a typed/content/history ref, reachability, authority, provenance, schema satisfaction, or required material-ref/cardinality satisfaction; cannot be persisted as an inferred object-body field.
BDB_BOOTSTRAP_PRECEDENCE_V1.group_precedence_semantics: For every two present groups i<j, every same-commit node whose exact kind is in group i has an order-only edge to every same-commit node whose exact kind is in group j. Missing optional groups create no nodes/edges. Within one group and for nodes not ordered by this profile, normal Kahn zero-indegree typed tie-break applies.
BDB_BOOTSTRAP_PRECEDENCE_V1.legacy_raw_ref_semantics: legacy_raw_ref remains EXPLICIT_COMPLETE without source_generation_ref; source_generation-before-legacy_raw_ref is an order-only bootstrap constraint, not a content reference.
BDB_BOOTSTRAP_PRECEDENCE_V1.union_graph_semantics: canonical closure graph edges = typed same-commit content-reference dependency edges UNION active order-only precedence edges; cycle in union graph rejects; exactly one Kahn sort is run over the union.

const.AUTHORIZED_ACTOR_REF: Exact actor identity whose authorizing capability/role is established by prior accepted or installation-pinned trust/policy context before the command it authorizes. Same-commit actor creation/role elevation cannot authorize that same command.
const.CONTENT_OBJECT: Reference to immutable content participating in the current content closure. Same-commit targets MUST be earlier nodes in the canonical topological sequence; prior accepted immutable objects are permitted only where the type-specific contract explicitly allows reuse.
const.CONTENT_OR_PRIOR: Typed immutable content reference may resolve either to a prior accepted object or to an earlier node in the same validated canonical topological content closure. It MUST NOT resolve to self/future content or to acceptance/history provenance.
const.GOVERNANCE_AUTHORITY_REF: Exact authority identity valid for foundation-governance decisions. It must be established independently of the record it authorizes (external authorized governance identity or prior accepted governance authority); same-record/same-commit self-authorization is forbidden. It is not a profile reference and does not create campaign runtime authority.
const.HISTORY_CONTEXT_BINDING: Semantic policy/spec/profile binding constrained by the exact HISTORY_INPUT of the referring object. For EMPTY_HISTORY/EMPTY_HISTORY_CUT it MUST equal the exact external INSTALLATION_BOOTSTRAP_PROFILE_V1 pin; for accepted history it MUST resolve from the exact prior accepted history/policy/spec/profile state represented by that input cut/head. It may be carried inside HistoryCut or copied into another object only under an equality constraint. Same-commit semantic self-upgrade/substitution is forbidden.
const.HISTORY_INPUT: History/acceptance input reference. It MUST resolve to the exact prior accepted cut/head, or to the tagged EMPTY_HISTORY/EMPTY_HISTORY_CUT only for the one initialization context. It is never an ordinary same-commit content reference.
const.PINNED_INSTALLATION_REF: Exact external LOCAL_PINNED installation trust-root reference used only by the initialization boundary. It is not mutable campaign state and cannot be silently replaced by current workspace state.
const.PINNED_PROFILE_REF: Exact profile pin whose bytes/digest or qualified logical binding is fixed by the governing accepted/pinned profile. Consumers may not substitute a different installed/latest profile.
const.POST_ACCEPTANCE_SIDECAR: Reference emitted only after the accepting commit/head identity exists and kept outside that commit/object preimage. It may point to the accepted commit/head/result objects but cannot participate in the pre-acceptance content DAG.
const.PRIOR_ACCEPTED_ONLY: Backward-only reference to an exact already accepted object/head before the current command input cut. Same-commit, self and future targets are forbidden.
const.SOURCE_AUTHORITY_REF: Exact repository/snapshot authority identity authorized by the pinned SourceIdentityProfile/trust boundary independently of the SourceIdentity/SourceGeneration object being created. A same-commit object cannot bootstrap its own repository/snapshot authority.

const.EMPTY_HISTORY: tagged first-history parent sentinel; not a canonical object
const.EMPTY_HISTORY_CUT: tagged first-history input cut; not an accepted fact
const.PRIOR_ACCEPTED_ONLY: reference class marker: exact referenced object/revision/result must already be accepted before the referring object input cut; never same-commit future content
const.accepted_event_ref: exact accepted event position/reference (accepting_commit_hash, ordinal, event type) resolved only from canonical accepted history; never same-commit future event provenance
const.assigned_input_ref: exact immutable/raw assigned input identity admitted by the active inventory schema; never an InputDispositionRecord or ScopeStateRecord
const.campaign_ref: logical campaign identity established by accepted campaign_genesis or successor_campaign_genesis; not a standalone mutable/canonical campaign-state object
const.candidate_manifest_raw_digest: exact RawDigest of reviewed candidate manifest bytes
const.coverage_obligation_summary_ref: exact coverage summary/projection reference on pinned cut
const.dependency_graph_ref: exact dependency graph object/reference admitted by evidence schema
const.materiality_subject_ref: exact accepted surface_record, surface_key, invariant_revision or typed scope reference being assessed; subject never points forward to its own assessment
const.predecessor_pin_ref: exact predecessor identity/freshness pin authorized by the active INSTALLATION_BOOTSTRAP_PROFILE_V1 or one of its exact pinned governing policy/trust artifacts; not arbitrary workspace state and not mutable campaign authority
const.public_conclusion_statement_ref: exact immutable public conclusion statement/export reference
const.registered_immutable_object: any object kind registered for the active profile and allowed by the exact schema
const.release_reassessment_input_ref: exact fresh release assessment input reference
const.review_raw_digest: exact RawDigest of independent review bytes
const.scope_decision_ref: exact accepted scope applicability/exclusion decision valid at the record history cut
const.typed_scope_ref: registered scope/surface/invariant/claim reference admitted by exact schema

schema.const: Every kind used by the author-qualified foundation/reference-slice must be registered. Every kind in foundation_inline_reference_contract_kinds must use EXPLICIT_COMPLETE typed-ref/cardinality semantics; material-ref array ordering is the pinned contract default CANONICAL_TYPED_REF_SORT_NO_DUPLICATES_UNLESS_FIELD_OVERRIDE unless a field-specific ordering_rules override exists. Other future kinds may be SCHEMA_BOUND_BEFORE_FIRST_ACCEPTANCE and are fail-closed until exact executable schema/ref binding exists; unknown runtime kind is UNREGISTERED_CONTRACT_KIND.
This pinned registry constrains contract kinds and validation but is not accepted runtime state authority; CANONICAL_ACCEPTED_HISTORY remains runtime truth authority.

schema_ref is a frozen semantic SchemaRegistry key. Foundation freeze binds semantic key/contract; before first runtime acceptance of that kind, implementation MUST bind exact executable schema bytes+digest or fail SCHEMA_BYTES_NOT_BOUND. Schema binding may not change frozen semantics without a new foundation revision. Foundation freeze binds semantic schema keys/contracts; exact executable schema bytes+digest are required before first runtime acceptance of each kind, and later binding cannot change frozen semantics without a new foundation revision.
